# BudgetBliss

> A free, fully manual personal finance tracker. Users log every income and
> expense themselves — there is no bank, UPI or card account linking, by design.
> Amounts are in Indian rupees (INR).

## What it is

BudgetBliss is a free personal finance tracker where you enter every
transaction yourself instead of linking a bank account. It tracks four account
types — savings, credit card, digital wallet and cash — derives every balance
from your transaction history, and supports category budgets, savings goals and
split expenses.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, feature list, pricing and FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): What data is stored, and the breach disclaimer.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms of use.

## Features

- Manual income and expense logging, one entry at a time
- Four account types: savings (minimum-balance threshold), credit card (credit
  limit and utilisation warnings), digital wallet (balance cap), cash
- Balances derived from transaction history rather than stored as running totals
- Monthly per-category budgets
- Savings goals funded by earmarked contributions from real income
- Split expenses: one bill divided into linked entries reconciling to one payment
- Credit card utilisation warning at 40% of the limit
- Spending-category breakdown, charts and a financial calendar
- Demo account available without signup

## What it deliberately does not do

- No bank, UPI or card account linking — not planned
- No automatic transaction import or categorisation
- No selling or sharing of personal financial data
- No collection of full card numbers, CVV or PIN — last four digits only

## Pricing

- Free plan: ₹0. Covers every feature that currently exists.
- Pro (₹199/month) and Family (₹499/month): planned, not yet purchasable. There
  is no payment processing integrated at this time.

## Key facts

- Fully manual by design; the friction of typing an amount is the intended
  behaviour-change mechanism
- Only the last four digits of a card are ever collected
- A plain-language breach disclaimer is surfaced on the account form and the
  privacy page
- Built by Tamal Biswas as an independent side project
